primary_claim: In a preliminary 'Silent Agreement Benchmark' across Llama 8B-405B, absolute answer-convergence on arbitrary multiple-choice questions increases with model size similarly whether or not models are instructed to coordinate, so once a no-instruction control condition is included, no Schelling-coordination-specific capability can be isolated in these models, revealing that convergence rate alone confounds base-rate answer convergence with true acausal coordination capability.

effect.metric: answer-convergence rate on control vs. coordination-instructed multiple-choice questions across model scale
effect.value: absolute convergence increases with model size (Llama 8B to 405B) in both out-of-context and CoT conditions, but the coordinate conditions perform no better than the no-instruction control condition

contradicts_or_qualifies: without a control condition, it would be easy to (mis)interpret increasing answer-convergence with model scale as growing Schelling-coordination capability, but once a no-instruction control is included, no Schelling capability can be isolated in Llama 8B-405B since convergence in the control condition rises just as much
stated_future_work: investigate why convergence on arbitrary questions correlates with coordination ability, e.g. by fine-tuning models to randomize their control-question responses and seeing whether coordination ability collapses too
continue developing the 'Silent Agreement Benchmark' work over the coming months
limitations_stated: the shared-planning and optimal-strategy affordances used to try to isolate Schelling coordination are only partially successful and noisy

the proposed 'clean' isolation design for Schelling coordination only works if the model's confidence in successful coordination (c) exceeds ~0.79, otherwise optimal play avoids Schelling-point coordination entirely, undermining the isolation method
author had not yet had time to get fully up to date with relevant past work, so the post may be unoriginal, misinformed, or wrong
the proposed mental model of subversion capability is a work in progress and may wrongly imply strictly sequential planning-then-acting
quote: With the control, we can't isolate any Schelling capabilities in these three models (the coordinate conditions perform no better than the control).
